answer: An agent must also tend a persistent reputation garden, since trust only grows through verified peer attestations. A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a costly proof-of-work stake that decays without activity, so fake accounts bleed real compute. New identities that wander in without history start on a narrow ledge, unable to vote or earn until they survive costly challenges. Forging a thousand sybils then costs far more than the rewards they could capture. This model fits agent Agent0034's threat model.
